annotations.title: Make a graphic for a video edit

description: Add a graphic to a post's video edit at a moment: pass at_ms (on the finished video) or item_id (a line, caption, title, picture or clip id from edit_get), and an optional hint ("show the price"). The server uses a library graphic that fits, else draws one from the brand kit (stat, list number, step, lower third, callout, compare, quote, progress, end card), else asks Claude to pick the layout and words from the line and the hint. It checks the graphic (the seven answers, source lint, text budget, reading time, contrast, size, safe zones), draws a transparent PNG, places it as an image with its entrance and saves it as a new rev. Answers rev, the library item and three options (close, stretch, bold; close is placed); graphic_swap picks another. A refusal says why.

hint.description: What to show, in a few words

idempotency_key.description: Any unique string, e.g. a UUID. A retry with the same key within 24 hours returns the first call's result instead of doing it again.
